hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has a separate entry for Laba [lau] or South Loloda. But according to **hh:hdial:vanBaarda:Loda** Laba differs little from Loloda of Baru of the Loloda [loa] entry and other surveys see no positive reason for separating the two (**hh:hv:GrimesGrimes:NMoluccas**, **hh:hv:Voorhoeve:NMoluccas**). See also: Loloda-Laba [loa].
